name: 21-blog-article-pumpkin-bread
raw:
Pumpkin Bread
Every fall my kitchen smells like cinnamon, and this loaf is the reason. I first made it for a school bake sale and never stopped.
Ingredients
- 1 can (15 oz) pumpkin puree
- 1 cup sugar
- 1/2 cup oil
- 2 eggs
- 1 3/4 cups flour
- 2 tsp pumpkin pie spice
Instructions
- Heat the oven to 350 F and grease a loaf pan.
- Whisk the pumpkin, sugar, oil and eggs.
- Stir in the flour and spice, pour into the pan and bake for 60 minutes.

name: 22-blog-comments-sidebar
raw:
Chicken Tikka Masala
Creamy, mild and ready in an hour.
What you'll need
- 1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
- 1 cup yogurt
- 2 tbsp tikka masala paste
- 1 can (14 oz) tomato sauce
- 1/2 cup cream
Directions
- Marinate the chicken in the yogurt and half the paste for 30 minutes.
- Sear the chicken in a hot pan.
- Add the tomato sauce, remaining paste and cream and simmer for 15 minutes.

name: 24-blog-role-main
raw:
Mushroom Risotto
Patience is the secret ingredient.
Ingredients
1 1/2 cups arborio rice
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
4 cups hot stock
1/2 cup parmesan
Instructions
1. Brown the mushrooms and set them aside.
2. Toast the rice, then add stock a ladle at a time, stirring.
3. Fold in the mushrooms and parmesan.
